name: Action Scene
description: Declarative preset for physical conflict and kinetic set-pieces. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Keep spatial causality, cost, and clarity in motion-heavy scenes.
writing_goals: Track who is where before introducing a new beat
Make each move change the tactical situation
Show cost on body, time, or resource
End on a new constraint, not a reset
constraints: Avoid choreography that cannot be visualized in space
Do not hide injuries or spent resources without a later payoff plan
Do not pause the fight for long internal essays
checklist: Geography of the fight is readable
A resource is spent or a wound is taken
The victor or escape has a cost
